text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Angolan President Jose Eduardo dos Santos met vice president of Norway's Norse Hydro company. Discussions centred around the gas and oil business as well as increased investment by Norse Hydro in the agriculture sector.
- UNITA presented its proposal for a basic programme of a new unity government which included points such as consolidation of peace, integration of all territories, democracy and the economy.

- U.N. police travelled to the troubled region around the southwestern city of Cubal and said they had found no evidence to support radio reports that UNITA and the Angolan military had clashed there.
